title: Replace the regex import scan in chat-entry-set.pin.test.ts with a TypeScript AST import walk
evidence: PR 1483 review rounds each found one more import form the regex missed: first a renamed re-export imported by name, then a default re-export taken by a default import. The scan also does not normalise .js-suffixed specifiers or app/-rooted and other non-relative paths. The real fix is to resolve imports with the TypeScript compiler (for example ts.preProcessFile or its module resolver), so there is no fourth regex round. The pin stays a best-effort early warning; the guards are the three production checks in api.chat.ts, app-routes.server.ts and chat.server.ts. (H68)
